'''Darth Malak's armor''' was a suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was possibly worn by [[Darth Malak]]. However, due to the fact that the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] body was destroyed along with the [[Star Forge]], it was unlikely that this particular armor was one that he actually wore in daily use. It was believed that this armor came into the possession of [[Meetra Surik]] towards the end of the [[Old Sith Wars]].
